description: The money report of the workspace, from the payments fields of every project you can see: received, expenses (negative payments), net, expected and overdue money; by month, by project and by client; and every payment (date, issue, client, amount, converted value, received or expected). Each payment is converted to `currency` at the National Bank of Ukraine rate of its date. Use it for "how much did we earn this year?", "who owes us?", "what comes in next month?".

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: received payments from this day

project.description: one project (key or id) with its sub-projects

rows.description: include every payment (default false: totals, months, projects and clients only)

name: get_money_report
